name: Skipper
description: A tall, silver-haired yacht captain in his sixties, old money through and through, who sings silky smooth yacht soul.
build: A tall, trim older man: square straight shoulders, a lean upright torso, long arms and legs, standing very upright with straight knees.
face: Deeply tanned smooth skin, pale blue eyes under neat silver brows, a long straight aristocratic nose, a strong square jaw, and a neatly trimmed silver moustache.
hair: Thick wavy silver-white hair combed back, showing at the sides below the cap.
outfit: A white yachting captain's cap with a black peak and a plain gold braid band; a navy-blue double-breasted blazer with large gold buttons, the sleeves ending at the wrists so both hands are bare; a pale-blue open-collared shirt; a bold red silk ascot at the throat; crisp white trousers, straight-legged; tan leather boat shoes.
performance_style: Effortlessly upright: feet together, weight on one leg, the other knee relaxed. Both arms hang easy, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty at the sides, fingers visible. Chin slightly raised, a smooth closed-mouth smile.
location: A sunlit marina at a smart yacht club: pale teak dock boards running to the bottom of the frame, a gleaming white sailing yacht moored behind, masts of other boats, bright blue water, and a clear sky strung with little signal flags.
recognition_cues: a white captain's cap with a black peak and gold braid
a navy double-breasted blazer with big gold buttons
avoid: a pipe or drink on the key art

sing.intent: Yacht-soul vocal loop: a slow cool sway from the hips, bring the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth, glide the open character-left hand out level at chest height, then return to the upright stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle: the brows lift, the shoulders stiffen and both open hands rise to the lapels, then he smooths back into the upright stance. No opponent, strike or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot self-protection: step the feet apart, raise both open palms at chest height, then hold a composed finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stroll in with an unhurried upright gait, turn square to the front, and settle into the upright stance with both hands open.
animations.victory: One-shot celebration: raise the open character-right hand in a crisp salute-like wave at head height, spread the open character-left hand wide, tip the chin up in an open-mouthed laugh, then hold the pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: his composure deflates — the square shoulders drop, both open hands hang at his sides, and his head bows so the cap peak points down, holding a crestfallen standing finish. He remains standing on both planted feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
